**Revising Time Spinner Design**

I'm currently focused on redesigning the `TimeSpinner` component. I'm aiming for a cleaner time picker layout, discarding the bulky button and heavy fonts. I'm leaning toward subtle, compact input cards for hours and minutes, using `w-14 h-11 text-xl font-medium font-mono rounded` classes for the desired aesthetics.

args.Description: Redesign TimeSpinner with sleek minimalist inputs and compact elegant buttons
